findings.title: terminal_failed can encode unknown outcomes and close an unresolved tool_started
findings.evidence: terminal_failed accepts any allowlisted non-ok result class, including commit_unknown and rollback_proven. The transition table also permits terminal_failed from phases 3 and 5, where a durable tool_started has no durable tool_result. Docs/41 requires missing tool_result and commit unknown to remain pending_unknown; converting either to terminal_failed risks a false not_committed recovery classification.
findings.recommendation: Restrict terminal_failed to an explicit phase/result-class matrix; reject direct terminalization from tool_started/no-result phases and reject commit_unknown/rollback_proven as terminal_failed result classes. Add Append/reopen negative and positive chain tests proving unresolved outcomes cannot recover as not_committed.
